production.note: US model years 2011-2014 for the 5.0-liter GT. Start: Ford's release 'THE 5.0-LITER IS BACK: 2011 FORD MUSTANG GT LEADS CLASS WITH 412 HP'. End: KBB lists a 2014 Mustang GT Coupe 2D at '420 @ 6500 RPM' (kbb-mustang-gt-2014); the S550 followed for 2015. The 2005-2010 S197 GT (4.6 liter) is a different car.

body.note: Ford's specifications list Coupe and Convertible; John Heilig reviewed the '2011 Ford Mustang GT Convertible' (autochannel-mustang-gt-2011).

transmission.note: '6-speed manual transmission or six-speed automatic'. Cars.com 2011 GT: '6-Speed A/T ... 6-Speed M/T' (cars-com-mustang-gt-2011).

powerHp.note: 2011 model year. PROVISIONAL (manufacturer estimate and databases). Ford's pre-launch specification table, reproduced by AutoGuide, gives "Horsepower 412 @ 6,500 rpm (est.)"; AutoGuide's text: "The return of the 5.0-liter brings with it 412-hp at 6500 rpm". Cars.com 2011 '2dr Cpe GT': "SAE Net Horsepower: 412 @ 6500" (cars-com-mustang-gt-2011); KBB 2012 GT Coupe: "412 @ 6500 RPM" (kbb-mustang-gt-2012). 2013-2014: 420 hp (KBB 2013 and 2014 GT Coupe: "420 @ 6500 RPM", kbb-mustang-gt-2013, kbb-mustang-gt-2014). Each rating covers two of the four years, so the launch year is the reference year.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (databases and one article). 2011 GT coupe. Quote (Cars.com 2011 '2dr Cpe GT'): "Base Curb Weight: 3,605 lbs". KBB 2011 GT Coupe 2D (transmission 'Manual'): "Curb Weight: 3605 lbs." (kbb-mustang-gt-2011); KBB 2012: "3605 lbs." (kbb-mustang-gt-2012). AutoGuide's first drive (Mark Atkinson) says it "weighs only 3,600 lbs" (autoguide-mustang-gt-2011-first-drive). Ford's pre-launch table, as reproduced by AutoGuide, gives only estimates: "BASE CURB WEIGHT (POUNDS) Manual transmission 3,875 (est.)", which do not count (ford-mustang-gt-2011-release). For later years KBB gives 3,602 lb (2013) and 3,618 lb (2014). Heilig's 2011 GT convertible: "3,720 lbs." (autochannel-mustang-gt-2011).

sources.publisher: Ford Motor Company (release reproduced by AutoGuide)

discrepancies.reason: Ford's pre-launch table (as reproduced by AutoGuide) gives '3,875 (est.)' for the manual coupe; Cars.com, KBB and AutoGuide's first drive give 3,600-3,605 lb for the production car.
discrepancies.resolution: 3,605 lb used: Ford's figure is labelled an estimate and does not count; three later sources agree within 0.2%.

provisionalNote: Weight (3,605 lb) rests on databases (Cars.com, KBB) and one article (AutoGuide, '3,600 lbs'), all agreeing; Ford's only figure found is a pre-launch estimate (3,875 lb est.). A final Ford figure (2011 brochure or technical specifications) or a major magazine spec panel would replace it. Power (412 hp) rests on Ford's pre-launch table, labelled "(est.)", and on Cars.com and KBB (databases), all agreeing; a final Ford figure would replace it.
